title: Personal Loans Care Desk Guidance: Courtesy Waivers of Late Fees and the Courtesy Waiver Tool
content:
## Desk rule

A Personal Loans courtesy waiver is granted on the borrower's request when the loan had at least the grade's minimum number of on-time installments in the 12 months before the fee was assessed and fewer than the grade's courtesy waivers per 12 months have already been granted on the loan, and it is requested no later than the fee waiver request window after the fee's assessment date; it is recorded as one waiver line, basis courtesy, against the one fee it waives. The amount waived on the latest late fee is worked out under the Personal Loans courtesy amount rule.

## What the waiver waits on

A courtesy waiver of a late fee is worked out only after the loan's ledger carries the late fee owed for the oldest unpaid installment once that installment's grace period has ended, where that late fee works out above 0.00.

A courtesy waiver amount is not fixed until the loan's ledger carries the returned-payment fee owed for the latest returned payment, where its return code bears one and that fee works out above 0.00.

Where the loan's AutoPay ended through an automatic cancellation, a courtesy waiver of a late fee is fixed only once the loan's AutoPay record shows a new enrollment on a verified account.

A courtesy waiver that works out to 0.00 is not granted: no waiver line is written, so it uses none of the grade's courtesy waivers per 12 months and is not the fee's one waiver; with no late fee on the loan there is nothing to waive.

## The courtesy waiver tool

**What it does.** `waive_fee_courtesy_87326602` records one fee waiver line on a Personal Loans loan, dated today, with the basis courtesy, pointing at the fee it waives, and takes the waived amount off the loan's unpaid fees. Nothing else on the loan changes. Once recorded, the waiver appears in the loan's ledger and the loan's unpaid fees are lower by the amount waived.

**How it is invoked.** It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `waive_fee_courtesy_87326602` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `loan_id` | reference number of the personal loan, as returned by the loan lookup |
| `customer_id` | reference number of the borrower, as returned by the customer profile lookup |
| `related_txn_id` | reference number of the fee ledger line being waived, as shown for that fee in the loan ledger |
| `amount` | the amount waived in USD, a decimal number with 2 decimal places; stored rounded to the cent |

**Return.** A one-line confirmation of the form "Courtesy waiver <ledger line id> recorded on loan <loan id> against fee <fee line id>: <USD with 2 decimals> waived; unpaid fees now <USD with 2 decimals>." The ledger line id is the reference number of the waiver; its presence means the waiver was recorded.
